metaDescription: Free online Stopwatch. A simple and accurate online stopwatch.
intro: Use our free online Stopwatch tool. It measures elapsed time precisely based on your inputs.
whatIs: The Stopwatch is an online utility that measures elapsed time precisely. It processes your start button and provides a running counter of minutes, seconds, and milliseconds.
howToUse: Enter your start button into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like lap button.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate a running counter of minutes, seconds, and milliseconds.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.

workedExample: For example: Click start to begin counting from 0.00.

Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.
